derived.method: CalPERS shares ÷ shares outstanding (3,236,233 ÷ 1,640,087,251 at October 28, 2026)

inputs.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 26, 2026, cover page
inputs.quote: Number of shares outstanding of the registrant's common stock, $0.01 par value per share, as of October 28, 2026: 1,640,087,251

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: On January 30, 2026, there were 5,094 registered holders of our common stock, and the closing price of our common stock was $236.73 per share as reported on NASDAQ.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026; Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count at October 28, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record are from the FY2025 10-K.
